<timestamp>Thursday, Nov 19, 2026, 4:31 PM (UTC-8)</timestamp>
<user_query>
is this entire website a live link yet? have we deployed/
</user_query>
I'll check the project for a deployed URL and any hosting or deploy setup.

Yes. The site is deployed and live at **https://waypoint-5o4r.onrender.com**.

I requested that URL just now and it returned HTTP 200 with the Waypoint sign-in page, so the service is up.

It is a Render free-plan web service defined in `render.yaml`, deployed from the `main` branch. Each push to `main` redeploys it. The free plan sleeps when idle, so the first load after a quiet period can take up to a minute. The disk is wiped on sleep, restart, or redeploy unless Upstash Redis is configured, so sample students come back from seed data and accounts or Bot writes do not persist.
